description: The main links of a website, with optional drop-down panels. The open trigger and the active link use the light-green pill.
tip: Navigation Menu is for a site header on wide screens. On phones, show the same links in a Sheet or Drawer.

noViewport.title: Without viewport
noViewport.description: viewport={false} opens each panel right under its trigger. The active prop marks the current page.

parts.trigger: Button that opens a panel, with an arrow.
parts.link: A link inside a panel or at the top level.
parts.viewport: Shared box the panels open in; resizes and slides between panels.
parts.indicator: Optional small arrow under the open trigger.
parts.triggerStyle: CSS class function that gives a top-level link the trigger look.

props.viewport: true = every panel opens in one animated box; false = under each trigger.
props.active: Marks the link of the current page.
props.delayDuration: Delay (ms) before a panel opens on hover.
